This dish has a little spicy taste.
column6: 味 is mostly used in words such as 味道, 香味 and 辣味.

Please smell it; what does this smell like?

column6: 污染 is also a noun ("pollution").

There are many mountains in western China.

Compared with last year, this year is much colder.

column6: 相反 is also used on its own at the start of a sentence to mean "on the contrary".

Friends need to help each other.

Being together with family is happiness.
column6: 幸福 is also an adjective: 她觉得自己很幸福.
